# xkb.sccl.cc

XKB config generator for keyboard layouts. Create, customize, and export XKB configuration files with a visual keyboard editor.

## Features
- Visual matrix editor for keyboard layouts
- Multiple layers support (Base, Shift, AltGr, AltGr+Shift)
- Pre-built templates (Planck, Preonic, Ergodox, 60%, Corne, Split)
- Export to XKB config format
- Import/Export layout as JSON

## Usage
Click on any key to assign a new character. Use the layer tabs to define different layers. Copy the generated XKB config or export/import your layout.
